description: This file implements advanced session management functions for the CCSP CWMP protocol, including timer handlers, access control, and session state transitions.

classes.name: PCCSP_CWMP_SESSION_OBJECT
classes.description: Struct representing a CWMP session object, containing session state, locks, timers, and processor references.

classes.name: PCCSP_CWMP_PROCESSOR_OBJECT
classes.description: Struct representing the processor managing the CWMP session, including signal methods.

classes.name: PCCSP_CWMP_CPE_CONTROLLER_OBJECT
classes.description: Struct representing the CPE controller, providing configuration and status interfaces.

classes.name: PCCSP_CWMP_CFG_INTERFACE
classes.description: Interface for configuration-related methods such as GetRetryInformDelay.

classes.name: PANSC_TIMER_DESCRIPTOR_OBJECT
classes.description: Struct for timer objects used to manage session, retry, and notification timers.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmpsoAcqAccess(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Acquires lock access for the session object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmpsoRelAccess(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Releases lock access for the session object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmpsoSessionTimerInvoke(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Handles session timeout event, transitioning session state and signaling the processor.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmpsoSessionRetryTimerInvoke(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Handles retry timer expiry, initiating a re-connection attempt.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmpsoDelayedActiveNotifTimerInvoke(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Handles delayed active notification timer expiry, resumes session to send notifications.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmpsoStartRetryTimer(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Starts the retry timer with an interval based on retry count and configuration.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmpsoCancelRetryDelay(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,BOOL bConnectAgain)
methods.description: Cancels retry delay, resets retry count, and may initiate an immediate inform.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmpsoStopDelayedActiveNotifTimer(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Stops the delayed active notification timer.
